findings.detail: Paused playback renders .vp-big, but no dedicated .vp-big CSS rule existed in the renderer styles; it inherited generic button appearance.
The volume range was rendered as a rotated horizontal range while applying margin-top:-4px to the thumb, which shifts the thumb across the track after rotation.

changes.detail: Added an explicit 48x48 centered playback action with an opaque, non-blurred surface, visible hover/focus states, and no generic button sizing.
Changed the volume input to a native vertical range using vertical writing mode and removed the rotated-thumb offset.

verification.visualReviewReason: Computer Use listed the existing Win-Box window as minimized. Activation detected user input; the required state refresh still reported minimized. No further input was injected.
remainingVisualScope: Verify the actual pause/play control size and backdrop in the packaged player.
Verify the volume thumb is centered on-screen.
Complete contrast and selected-state checks across all pages, native menus, themes, DPI scales, and narrow layouts.
